About This Project

Project Overview

This is a modern Next.js application built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. It demonstrates best practices for React development and includes a clean, scalable project structure.

The project features server-side rendering, static site generation, and a component-based architecture that makes it easy to maintain and extend.

Technologies Used

  • Next.js 14 - React framework
  • TypeScript - Type safety
  • Tailwind CSS - Utility-first CSS
  • ESLint - Code linting
  • App Router - Modern routing system
